svg.text: Girlboss | Executive Assistant at Anchor Labs Inc.

text.tspan: I used to handle this badly. Showing up for 35
minutes still counts.
What changed is simpler than it sounds. I
missed three days, then restarted without a
dramatic reboot speech.
A sustainable pace is a competitive advantage.
That is all I have tonight.
Mobility work prevents the dramatic setbacks.
Protein at breakfast made afternoon cravings
less dramatic.
Show up for the boring weeks. That is where
fitness is built.
I measure progress by how stairs feel, not
only by the mirror.
Small sessions keep the identity alive.
I chose a program I can finish on a busy week,
not a fantasy week.
Compare yourself to last month, not to an
influencer's highlight.
I missed three days, then restarted without a
dramatic reboot speech.
You cannot out-train a calendar you refuse to
defend.
Protein at breakfast made afternoon cravings
less dramatic.
Compare yourself to last month, not to an
influencer's highlight.
I measure progress by how stairs feel, not
only by the mirror.
Compare yourself to last month, not to an
influencer's highlight.
I write the next workout in the calendar
before I leave the current one.
Your future joints are counting on today's
unglamorous choices.
I track sleep more carefully than I track PRs.
A sustainable pace is a competitive advantage.
